# Multi-sample Single-cell RNA-seq in Bioconductor

Multi-sample scRNA-seq analysis broadly follows the same analysis step as for single-sample, but there are some key differences.
The process is well described in [OSCA](https://bioconductor.org/books/release/OSCA.multisample/).

Below, a demo multi-sample dataset is loaded, containing single-cell data from 8 matched lupus patients before and after IFN stimulation, which can be used for self-directed learning.


## Data loading

Data used are from Kang HM, et al. (2018). Multiplexed droplet single-cell RNA-sequencing using
natural genetic variation. *Nature Biotechnology* 36:89–94. [doi:10.1038/nbt.4042](https://doi.org/10.1038/nbt.4042).
PBMCs from 8 lupus patients, control and IFN-β stimulated, distributed via the muscData Bioconductor package.

````{r}

# find out more about the dataset
?Kang18_8vs8

sce<-Kang18_8vs8()

````
